manifest.description: Version the dist: write the resolved, dist-root publishable package.json.

version.description: Bump source version iff the built dist differs from the published tarball.

reconcile.description: Backfill/refresh this package's published-state.json cache entry from npm (integrity-gated, network-light).

verify.description: Load dist entry points as a consumer would.

release-reset.description: Detect (and, with --live, revert) a partial/half-generated release version+changelog step for this project. Dry-run by default.
